text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the specific movements you are experiencing, such as restlessness, tremors, or muscle stiffness, and have they been present since starting the risperidone? speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: This sounds like akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone. I will adjust your medication to alleviate this distressing restlessness. REQUEST TEST: Barnes Akathisia Rating Scale

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal Barnes Akathisia Rating Scale is surprising given your description of restlessness, so I need to rule out other causes.
